title: SAML Authentication
description: Enables user authentication by making your helpdesk a SAML Service Provider

settings_def.name: sso_url
settings_def.label: SSO: Single Sign On URL
settings_def.description: The SSO URL (provided by your SAML IdP)

settings_def.name: slo_url
settings_def.label: SLO: Single Log Off URL
settings_def.description: The SLO URL (provided by your SAML IdP)

settings_def.name: issuer_id
settings_def.label: Metadata: Issuer XML metadata URL
settings_def.description: The URL that contains the XML metadata information about your SAML IdP (provided by your SAML IdP)

settings_def.name: cert_fingerprint
settings_def.label: Certificate Fingerprint
settings_def.description: Your IdP should provide you with a fingerprint of their certificate (provided by your SAML IdP)

settings_def.name: login_custom_text
settings_def.label: Login Button Text
settings_def.description: The text that appears on the button on the login page. Only useful if your settings are for background SSO. This is also optional - leave blank to show no button.

settings_def.name: sso_type
settings_def.label: SSO Method
settings_def.description: When SSO is enabled, users will be automatically logged-in when they visit DeskPRO.

settings_def.name: auto_agent
settings_def.label: Auto Agent
settings_def.checkbox_label: Automatically create agents if they do not already exist

inline_dependant.name: auto_agent_permission_group
inline_dependant.label: Add new agents to this permission group
